title: Multiplayer Colors WIP
description:
In co-op, two players can pick the same character and then look identical everywhere. This mod gives each of them a slight, distinct color variation - brighter, darker, warmer, cooler - so you can tell them apart at a glance while they still clearly look like the same character.

Applies to the character in combat, at rest sites, in the shop and in the treasure room - companions included, so Osty, Byrdpip, Pael's Legion and the Regent's Sovereign Blade take their owner's color too - plus the character portrait, the little character icons on the map, map ink, map pings and remote targeting lines.

Each tinted figure also carries a faint aura in a colour that names its variation - white, black, red or blue - plus a drift of particles whose direction says the same thing: brighter drifts right, darker left, warmer up, cooler down. So two players stay tellable apart even when the game dims one of them, which it does to everyone in the back row of a fight.

Does nothing in single-player, and nothing when everyone picked a different character. No gameplay changes. No dependencies.

Character agnostic and mod friendly - safe to use alongside other character mods. Nothing is hard-coded per character: every color is derived at runtime from that character's own art and their own map color, so modded characters are handled automatically. Nothing needs adding to a list, and no update is needed here when a new character mod comes out.

Work-in-progress build shared for testing. Includes a 'tint' dev console command for previewing all four variations without needing four players.
changeNote: v0.1.38: the aura is measured on the whole art again, so it never goes stale on the treasure-room hands as they follow the cursor.
